text:
All three were bugs in the document viewer, and all three are fixed on main (8f64004). They show up once the orchestrator republishes the page.

- **List text cut out of the item:** the viewer ended a list item at the end of its first source line. A long item written over two lines lost its second line, which became a paragraph of its own. Now the item keeps all its lines. Wrapped paragraphs also join into one, as in any Markdown reader.
- **A section with a comma not linked:** the link pattern only accepted letters, digits, dots and dashes after the §. It now takes the whole name, commas included.
- **The section not first in the viewer:** two causes. The scroll was measured from the wrong box, so it landed past the section (that is why you saw "Looked at, not a problem" under "His named problems"). And a short last section, like "What is left", had nothing below it to scroll into. Now the heading is placed at the top from its real position, held there while the pictures above it load, and given room below when it is near the end.

Each has a check that fails on the old page and passes now (`kit/board/test_page_ux.js`, 38 checks).
